title: Absolutely Continuous Spectrum Under a Weighted L2 Condition
exact_target: Determine whether the stated weighted square-integrability condition forces infinitely many absolutely continuous spectral channels at nonnegative energies.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7900008 (AMR-078-0008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Barry Simon, Schrödinger operators in the twenty-first century, Mathematical Physics 2000, pp. 283–288, original Problem 8.
Wikipedia contributors, Simon problems, pinned revision 1335881350, The 2000 list. Existing catalogue wording adapted; CC BY-SA 4.0.

status_qualification: The brief catalogue statement does not specify local regularity or the self-adjoint realization. Those operator-domain hypotheses require consultation of the primary source, and are not invented here. Multiplicity on an interval is understood almost everywhere in spectral theory.
